votes.motion: Approve the work session meeting minutes of Tuesday, March 3, 2020 and Tuesday, April 21, 2020, as well as the formal meeting minutes of Tuesday, April 21, 2020 and the special limited formal meeting minutes of Tuesday, April 14, 2020.
votes.description: Approval of multiple prior meeting minutes including work session, formal, and special limited formal meetings from 2020.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on the Resolution authorizing the issuance and sale of Sales and Excise Tax Revenue and Refunding Bonds.
votes.description: Closes the public comment period for a resolution authorizing issuance of sales and excise tax revenue bonds to finance acquisition of library facilities from the Local Building Authority of Salt Lake City.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the 2020 Salt Lake City Street Lighting Master Plan ordinance to a future Council meeting.
votes.description: Closes the public comment period for an ordinance adopting the 2020 Street Lighting Master Plan and defers final action to a future meeting given public concerns about the plan's readiness.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on Budget Amendment No. 2 for Fiscal Year 2021-22 to a future Council meeting. (Initial Motion)
votes.description: Initial motion to close the public hearing and defer all action on the FY2021-22 Budget Amendment No. 2 to a future meeting; subsequently reconsidered.

votes.motion: Reconsider the previous vote on Budget Amendment No. 2 for Fiscal Year 2021-22.
votes.description: Motion to reconsider the initial motion that had deferred all action on Budget Amendment No. 2, allowing the Council to take partial action on the amendment.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing, defer action on all items except Item A1 to a future meeting, and adopt Ordinance 54 of 2021 approving Item A1 (Continued Funding for Downtown Ambassador Pilot Programs: North Temple and Rio Grande – $495,000 from General Fund Balance). (Reconsidered Motion)
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on FY2021-22 Budget Amendment No. 2, adopts partial funding for the Downtown Ambassador Pilot Programs, and defers remaining items to a future Council meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 53 of 2021 rezoning parcels at 833 West Hoyt Place and 834 West 200 North from R-1/5,000 and R-1/7,000 to SR-3, subject to a development agreement requiring protection of the single-family use and architecture of the existing structure at 834 West 200 North.
votes.description: Approves a zoning map amendment for two parcels in the Nielsen Estates area to SR-3, contingent on a development agreement protecting the existing home's single-family character.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 52 of 2021 amending city code pertaining to fence, wall, and hedge height requirements.
votes.description: Adopts zoning ordinance amendments removing the Special Exception process for over-height fences and defining by-right instances where taller fences are permitted, with standard limits of 4 feet in front yards and 6 feet in side/rear yards.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 34 of 2021 authorizing the waiver of lease fees at Salt Lake City International Airport to facilitate the operation of an Airport Military Service Members Lounge by the USO.
votes.description: Approves a public benefits analysis resolution waiving lease fees at SLC International Airport so the United Service Organizations (USO) can operate a free lounge for military service members and their families.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 35 of 2021 supporting Salt Lake City hosting the National League of Cities (NLC) Conference in 2025.
votes.description: A resolution expressing the City Council's support for Salt Lake City to serve as host of the National League of Cities Conference in 2025.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 33 of 2021 authorizing up to $23,600,000 of the City's General Obligation Bonds, Series 2021 (Street Reconstruction).
votes.description: Authorizes the issuance of voter-approved General Obligation bonds up to $23.6 million for street reconstruction, part of the City's 2018 Funding Our Future initiative, and grants authority to certain officers to approve final bond terms within set parameters.

votes.motion: Adopt the Consent Agenda except for Item 9 (Board Appointment: Racial Equity in Policing Commission – Carol Schifflett).
votes.description: Approves all consent agenda items including setting a public hearing date, board appointments for the City and County Building Conservancy and Use Committee, Police Civilian Review Board, and multiple Racial Equity in Policing Commission appointments, excluding the Carol Schifflett appointment.
